name: Hallmrk
tagline: The system of record for authenticating pre-owned luxury at scale.
positioning: Hallmrk gives enterprise resale platforms a defensible, audit-ready authentication layer for every handbag, watch, and sneaker they list.

hero.sub: Hallmrk turns authentication from a bottleneck into a service call. Route items to expert graders, capture verdicts, and issue tamper-evident certificates without leaving your ops stack.

features.title: Verdict engine
features.description: Combine computer vision, serial-registry lookups, and human grader sign-off into a single authentication verdict with a full evidence trail.

features.title: Certificate ledger
features.description: Issue tamper-evident digital certificates of authenticity that follow each item across resales, returns, and cross-border consignment.

features.title: Grader routing
features.description: Auto-assign items to specialists by category and brand, with SLA timers so a Birkin never waits behind a batch of sneakers.

features.title: Fraud intelligence
features.description: Flag superfake patterns, duplicated serials, and repeat-offender consignors before an item hits your marketplace.

features.title: Enterprise API
features.description: Drop authentication into your intake flow with idempotent endpoints, webhooks, and sandbox parity your engineers won't fight.

features.title: Audit console
features.description: Give compliance and insurers read-only access to grader decisions, timestamps, and imagery for any item, dating back years.

testimonials.quote: Before Hallmrk our authentication queue was a shared spreadsheet and a group chat. Now every verdict has an evidence trail our insurers actually accept. Dispute rates dropped by a third in one quarter.
testimonials.name: Danielle Fauré

testimonials.quote: We onboarded 40 graders across three regions and Hallmrk's routing kept SLAs intact through peak season. The certificate ledger became the reason buyers trust our resale tier.
testimonials.name: Marcus Oyelaran

testimonials.quote: The fraud intelligence caught a duplicated-serial ring we would have missed for months. Usage-based pricing meant we paid for exactly the volume we authenticated, no shelfware.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkatesh
